title: Partner / Cloud Marketplace 1:1 Prep - Jamie & AWS Marketplace (Draft)
content:
Context:
- Weekly 1:1 with AWS marketplace partner manager (recurring). Goal: unblock listing progress, align on co-selling enablement, sync on billing/integration blockers.
- Recent items: private listing pilot for a strategic customer queued; we shipped the new metering line item last week but need AWS-side validation.

Objectives for this 1:1:
1) Confirm AWS validation timeline for metering line item and any remaining compliance docs needed.
2) Discuss private/managed listing next steps and timeline for pilot customer (ACME Corp).
3) Align on promotional/co-marketing timeline for Q2 (webinar + joint blog).
4) Raise the billing/usage reporting discrepancies reported by Finance and get a contact for finance ops escalation.

High-level talking points / script:
- Quick status (30s): "Implemented metering change; currently in our staging; need AWS validation to flip to public/production. Private listing pilot request submitted for ACME Corp — need next-step guidance."
- Ask for AWS: "Who on Marketplace side will validate the metering telemetry? Can we get a firm date? If there are missing artifacts, list them now so we can ship by EOD."
- Private listing: "We want to run ACME pilot in a VPC-backed private listing. What are AWS's checklist items (legal, security questionnaire, listing config)? Any expected delays?"
- Co-marketing: "We propose a joint webinar in mid-April focused on 'scaling inference on AWS: cost & latency tradeoffs'. What slots are available for AWS-led comms? Who owns assets and approval flow?"
- Finance escalation: "Finance sees a ~3% discrepancy between our metered usage and AWS invoices for Jan. Need an ops contact to triage (reconciliation cadence)."

Partner-specific notes / asks:
- AWS Marketplace (primary for this 1:1):
  - Metering line item: need validation owner + ETA.
  - Private listing: list of required docs; pre-approved legal template?
  - Billing reconciliation: request finance ops contact + SLA for investigation.
  - Co-sell program: check eligibility for Marketplace co-sell badge and any revenue share changes for Q3.

- GCP / Azure (brief mentions if AWS asks):
  - GCP: our private listing flow is slightly different — note to ensure marketplace integration parity once AWS finishes.
  - Azure: ask about Azure Marketplace listing checklist if AWS raises any common blockers (we may parallelize).

Metrics / data points to share if asked:
- Current staging metering: last 7 days avg usage events = 1.2M, avg latency delta after SDK change = +6ms, successful sample exports = 99.7%.
- Pilot customer (ACME) expected peak usage: ~60k invocations/day (estimate from Sales).
- Billing discrepancy: internal recon shows 3% less on AWS invoice vs our metered events for Jan.

Open questions to surface:
- Is there any changes to AWS listing policy coming 2H 2026 that might affect private listings or metering?
- If AWS validation is delayed >2 weeks, can we proceed with a limited self-hosted pilot while continuing AWS approval?
- For the co-marketing webinar, does AWS require a lead registration target to greenlight promotion?

Risks / blockers to escalate now:
- Validation delay for metering blocks public listing and could delay revenue recognition for pilots.
- Billing discrepancy — if unresolved, could block invoice reconciliation with FinOps and delay payout.
- Legal questionnaire for private listings may take >3 weeks if AWS needs additional security attestations; need parallel path.

Proposed asks / next steps (action items during or after call):
- AWS: assign validation owner and provide ETA (ask for named contact). Owner: AWS marketplace validation team (request name). Due: EOD +3 business days.
- Jamie (owner): Share staging metering logs and schema by EOD to assigned validation owner. Due: 2026-02-17.
- Jordan: Follow up with ACME to confirm pilot start window and any network requirements. Due: 2026-02-19.
- Samir: Open finance ops ticket with AWS billing team and schedule reconciliation call. Due: 2026-02-18.
- Priya: Draft co-marketing brief (1 page) for webinar: objectives, target audience, proposed speakers, CTA. Due: 2026-02-24.

Notes to self / meeting prep checklist (quick):
- Bring staging logs link and one-pager on metering implementation.
- Prepare short demo script for private listing flow (2 min).
- Have ACME pilot summary (traffic profile) ready.
- Slack the partners channel to ask for AWS contact if not assigned yet.

Follow-up template to send after the call (quick email):
Subject: Recap + Action Items — AWS Marketplace 1:1 (Jamie)
Body: Thanks for the sync — recap of asks, assigned owners, and timelines. Attach staging logs, metering schema, and ACME pilot one-pager. Request confirmation of validation owner and next meeting slot if needed.

Unresolved / todo (notes):
- If AWS asks for additional security docs, loop Legal (Legal contact: Mei Chen).
- Confirm whether Marketplace co-sell badge requires a specific Revenue threshold — check with Gtm Ops.

Quick version for Slack to partners channel: "Meeting w/ AWS PM today 11a PT — priority: metering validation + private listing for ACME. Will ping if we need legal/billing help."

-- end of notes --
